query: I have an 89-year-old male patient. Among male ICU hospital admissions, what is the IQR of first (index) serum sodium?
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY value) - percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY value) AS interquartile_range FROM male_first_sodium_labevents;
